door_act1.png.prompt:
The attached reference image is a room from this game - match its art style, colour temperature, material feel, brush work and line weight exactly, so this door looks like it belongs in that room.

Draw ONLY A CLOSED DOUBLE DOOR, seen straight on from the front, filling the picture: a heavy STONE double gate set into the dungeon wall: two matching stone leaves that meet in the middle, banded with dark iron straps and rivets, a big iron ring handle on each leaf, worn and chipped at the corners, a few strands of dry moss in the seams. Cold grey stone, lit from the front by torchlight.

HARD RULES - the game splits this image down the exact middle and slides the two halves apart, so:
- the door MUST be perfectly SYMMETRICAL left-to-right, and the seam where the two leaves meet MUST be exactly at the horizontal centre of the picture, running straight from top to bottom
- the door must be CLOSED, with no gap and no light coming through
- nothing may cross the centre seam (no chain, no banner, no lock spanning both leaves)
- draw ONLY the door and its immediate frame. NO floor, NO walls beyond the frame, NO ceiling, NO characters, NO creatures, no text, no letters, no watermark

Cute cartoon storybook style, thick black outlines, flat colours with soft shading, not photorealistic.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the door.
Output 768x1024 PNG (taller than wide). Save the image as door_act1.png in the current directory and report the path.
